Ivy: quick flag 1: p99 on /api/generate in eu-central spiked ~150ms after we changed routing weights at 04:12 UTC. p50/p95 unchanged. link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/latency-eu-central
Marco: on it. which routing change?
Ivy: weight primary 0.95 -> 0.7, fallback 0.05 -> 0.3, rolled by autoscaler at 04:12
Dee: likely more traffic to quant-variant. median OK but quant variant has heavier tail when KV cache is cold
Marco: checked raw counts: p99 computed from ~240 samples in the hour, p95 uses ~11k -> p99 is low-sample noisy
Ivy: traces show many p99s hit model-quant and have `kvcache_miss` on first chunk
Dee: proposal: rollback weight to 0.95 (Ivy), add sample_count badge next to p99 (Marco), and add per-variant percentile split beneath endpoint breakdown (Dee)
Ivy: ops-bot, please rollback route eu-central primary weight -> 0.95 (requested by Ivy)
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Received rollback request from Ivy. Rolling route eu-central primary weight -> 0.95
Marco: UX: show yellow "p99 low-sample" badge when sample_count < 500 with tooltip "p99 may be unstable". Also surface provenance: last routing change timestamp on chart
Dee: long-term: compute CI for percentiles from sample counts and expose per-model tails. doc note: routing->cheap-variant tradeoff can increase endpoint tail
Ivy: thanks. watching for p99 to settle in next 10m; will post incident note to #incidents with timeline and follow-ups
Marco: ACK
Dee: ACK :thumbsup:
